lesson_title: He Turned Borrowed Pens Into a Business
hook_text: Every week someone at school begged to borrow a pen. One learner turned that into R180 profit.
clip_script: Kagiso notices a problem: learners always run out of pens and books, and the shop is far away. That is a need. His idea: buy stationery in bulk, sell it at break for less than the shop. His risk: R300 of his savings. His team: a table, a cash box, a friend and a plan. A month later: money back plus R180 profit, and a class that never goes without a pen. That is an entrepreneur: spot a need, have an idea, take a risk, earn a reward. Brave, honest and determined on the inside; pricing, records and selling skills on the outside. You can learn all of it.
visual_style: A whiteboard school gate with a small stationery table, a lightbulb idea, a risk scale and a profit coin.
mood: Inspiring and down to earth, a school-sized success.
pacing: A quick problem, a fast build of the business, then a calm toolkit summary.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and write down one need at your school that could become a business.
